verse-hero.purpose: The verse of the day in the home hero; Hafs only.

verse.purpose: Quran text in the surah reader, user-adjustable 1.2 to 2.6rem.

title.purpose: Sky pane names, footer column heads.

shadows.name: pane-night
shadows.purpose: Section panes at rest at night.

shadows.name: pane-lifted
shadows.purpose: Pane hover at night, with a 4px rise.

shadows.name: pane-dawn
shadows.purpose: Section panes at dawn; hover hairline rgba(201,150,47,.55).

shadows.name: card-glass
shadows.purpose: Cards and reading tiles at night, with backdrop-filter: blur(14px).

motion.name: word-rise
motion.value: 1.1s ease-out, 90ms per word after 300ms; from translateY(.4em) blur(10px)
motion.purpose: Hero verse rises word by word.

motion.name: cine-in
motion.purpose: Hero name, citation, search and actions.

motion.name: mist-drift
motion.purpose: Mist bands across the painted hills.

motion.name: fajr-rise
motion.value: view() timeline, entry 0% to entry 70%; from opacity .2, translateY(18px)
motion.purpose: Sky panes settle into place on scroll.

motion.name: hero-parallax
motion.value: --p from scroll: stage translateY(p*18%) scale(1.04+p*.1); content lifts 60px and fades
motion.purpose: Hero scene sinks as it scrolls away.

motion.name: video-fade
motion.purpose: Dawn video fades in over the painted scene once playing.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Words, entrances, mist, pane rise and parallax off; video never loaded.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one gold call to action: a full pill with a first-light cast.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:12px 20px; border:1.5px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; background:#E2B35A; color:#1A1204; font-weight:600; font-size:.875rem; box-shadow:0 8px 28px -8px rgba(243,205,126,.55); transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .2s, box-shadow .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#F3CD7E; box-shadow:0 12px 36px -8px rgba(243,205,126,.7); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2.5px solid #E2B35A; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary pill: paper at dawn, faint glass at night.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:12px 20px; border:1.5px solid #DDD5C6; border-radius:999px; background:#FBF9F4; color:#12142A; font-weight:600; font-size:.875rem; transition:border-color .2s, color .2s, transform .25s; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color:#3A4BA0; color:#3A4BA0; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2.5px solid #E2B35A; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Night Glass Header
components.description: Sticky night glass with one gold hairline; aria-current underline in first light.
components.html: منصة القرآن الكريمالرئيسيةالسورالقرّاء
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:10px 20px; background:rgba(7,11,30,.78); backdrop-filter:saturate(1.4) blur(18px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(1.4) blur(18px); box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(226,179,90,.28), 0 12px 32px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.8); } .ds-nav-brand { font-family:ReemKufi, "Noto Kufi Arabic", sans-serif; font-weight:700; color:#F7F3EA; margin-inline-end:auto; } .ds-nav-link { padding:8px 12px; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:500; color:#B9B6D3; text-decoration:none; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; transition:color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color:#fff; border-bottom-color:#F3CD7E; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2.5px solid #F0C46E; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Sky Pane
components.description: Signature section pane: night lit from below, 14px corners, rises 4px with a gold edge.
components.html: ١١٤ سورةالمصحفالسور كاملة بالرسم العثماني مع التلاوة
components.css: .ds-pane { display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-end; gap:4px; min-height:9rem; padding:20px; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; text-decoration:none; background-color:#1C2A6E; background-image:radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 130%, rgba(255,255,255,.16), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7,11,30,.35), rgba(7,11,30,0) 45%); color:#F7F3EA; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08), 0 18px 40px -22px rgba(0,0,0,.7); transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-pane:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(243,205,126,.35), 0 28px 50px -22px rgba(0,0,0,.8), 0 0 40px -10px rgba(243,205,126,.25); } .ds-pane:focus-visible { outline:2.5px solid #F0C46E; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-pane-count { align-self:flex-start; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; padding:2px 8px; border:1px solid rgba(238,241,236,.22); margin-bottom:auto; } .ds-pane-title { font-family:ReemKufi, "Noto Kufi Arabic", sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.5rem; line-height:1.25; } .ds-pane-desc { font-size:.875rem; color:#C9C5DE; }

components.css: .ds-pane-dawn { display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-end; gap:4px; min-height:9rem; padding:20px; border-radius:14px; text-decoration:none; background-color:#DDE1F6; background-image:radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 130%, rgba(255,255,255,.75), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.35), rgba(255,255,255,0) 45%); color:#16183A; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(22,24,58,.07), 0 14px 30px -22px rgba(22,24,58,.35); transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .5s; } .ds-pane-dawn:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(201,150,47,.55), 0 22px 40px -24px rgba(22,24,58,.45); } .ds-pane-dawn:focus-visible { outline:2.5px solid #E2B35A; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-pane-dawn-title { font-family:ReemKufi, "Noto Kufi Arabic", sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.5rem; } .ds-pane-dawn-desc { font-size:.875rem; color:#4A4C6E; }

components.name: Page Band
components.description: Each inner page opens on its own patch of sky with hills and a gold horizon.
components.css: .ds-band { --band:#2E3F9E; position:relative; overflow:hidden; padding:44px 24px 58px; border-radius:14px; color:#F7F3EA; background:radial-gradient(90% 120% at 50% 135%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--band) 85%, #F3CD7E 15%), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(60% 70% at 50% 120%, rgba(243,205,126,.22), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(180deg, #070B1E 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--band) 45%, #070B1E) 100%); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06), 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.6); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(243,205,126,.35); } .ds-band h1 { margin:0; font-family:ReemKufi, "Noto Kufi Arabic", sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.25rem); line-height:1.25; color:#FBF8F1; text-shadow:0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45); } .ds-band p { color:rgba(247,243,234,.8); }

components.description: The single 1px line of first light that replaces every tile strip.
components.css: .ds-horizon { height:1px; background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(226,179,90,0), rgba(243,205,126,.9) 50%, rgba(226,179,90,0)); box-shadow:0 0 18px 2px rgba(243,205,126,.25); }

narrative.overview:
The site is the sky in the last hour of night. Every page sits under a deep indigo night strewn with faint stars; the horizon at the foot of each band glows with first light; misty hills stand between. The verse of the day is the dawn itself: on the home page it rises out of the mist word by word, the only large thing on the screen. Fajr is the default world (`data-skin="fajr"` on `<html>`), and night is the default theme. Light mode is the same world after first light: the sky turns pale lilac and peach, reading surfaces become warm paper, and the ink is deep night blue. The home hero keeps its night scene in both themes, because it is the moment before dawn.

Depth comes from light, not ornament. Section tiles are panes of night lit from below, glass at night and dawn-tinted paper by day, set 12px apart with 14px corners. One gold line of first light, fading out at both ends, replaces every border strip and seals each band, the hero and the footer. Motion is the sky moving: mist drifts across the hills, panes rise into place as they scroll in, the hero scene sinks as it scrolls away, the verse rises word by word. Nothing in the world depicts a person; the prophets appear only as light.

Two alternate skins remain selectable from the skin switch and the phone menu's المظهر row: **Andalus** (the original zellige wall: cobalt, saffron, emerald and terracotta glaze tiles in grout, eight-point star geometry, square shoulders) and **Kiswah** (black and gold). Both are complete worlds in `globals.css`; this document describes Fajr, the primary system.
keyCharacteristics: Night sky by default (#070B1E with a star field), dawn paper in light mode (#FBF9F4 on #F3EFE7).
One accent: dawn gold (#E2B35A, #F0C46E at night) on pill primary buttons, the horizon line, focus and selection.
Panes, cards and bands at 14px corners; buttons are pills.
Glass at night (14px backdrop blur on cards, 18px on the header), paper at dawn.
A single 1px gold horizon line in place of zellige tile strips.
Reem Kufi for headings, Noto Kufi for UI, Hafs only for Quran text.
Motion: word-rise, mist-drift, fajr-rise view timeline, hero parallax; all off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only warm accent. It fills the primary button, draws the horizon line, rings focus and marks selection. A screen has one primary button group.

rules.name: The Sky Holds the Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue lives in the sky (bands, header, footer, hero, panes). Long reading sits on night glass or dawn paper with plain ink, never on a gradient sky.

rules.name: The Hafs Only Rule
rules.body: Verses are set in Hafs and nothing else is. Verified text is rendered byte-exact, never restyled into display type.

rules.name: The Inscription Rule
rules.body: Reem Kufi is for headings and pane names only; body, labels and controls stay in Noto Kufi.

rules.name: The Lit From Below Rule
rules.body: Panes take their light from the horizon: a radial glow at the foot and a 1px hairline. No glazed top lip, no 3px foot shadow.

dos: Do round panes, cards and page bands to 14px (`--radius-cine`) and make buttons full pills (999px).
Do make reading surfaces glass at night (night pane with a 14px backdrop blur) and warm paper at dawn (#FBF9F4 on #F3EFE7).
Do seal the hero, every band and the footer with the single 1px gold horizon line (#F3CD7E at night, #C9962F at dawn), fading out at both ends.
Do keep gold as the only warm accent: the primary pill, the horizon, focus and selection.
Do open every inner page with a page band in its section's sky, with stars above and hills at the foot.
Do group peer destinations the way the menu groups them (القرآن / المحتوى / إسلاميات) as sky panes 12px apart.
Do keep a painted CSS/SVG fallback under any hero video, and skip the video under reduced motion and Save-Data.
Do make every touch target at least 44px, and mark the current page with `aria-current="page"`.
Do set every verse in Hafs, byte-exact from the verified text.
donts: Don't use zellige ornament under Fajr: no tile stars, star-and-cross lattice on panes, diamond tile strips or glazed top lips.
Don't set long reading text on a gradient sky; it belongs on glass or paper.
Don't use a second warm accent or more than one primary button group on a screen.
Don't depict people, prophets or faces in any image, film or illustration; prophets appear only as light.
Don't set body or UI text in Reem Kufi, or any non-Quran text in Hafs.
Don't paraphrase a verse as a quotation or restyle verified text.
